title: Why college degrees are becoming worthless in 2026

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: College degrees are obsolete—AI now outperforms humans in 80% of jobs requiring a bachelor’s. (3 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: You’re wrong. Degrees still signal discipline, effort, and critical thinking—AI can’t replicate that. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Over 300,000 AI certifications exist—employers trust those more than outdated degrees. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Certifications don’t replace a degree’s depth. Real-world employers value structured learning. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: College builds networks, research skills, and resilience—AI can’t teach that. (4 sec)
